headline: One Ingredient. One Purpose.
body: Erbology Hemp Seed Oil is organic, cold-pressed hemp seed oil — nothing added, nothing to interpret. A simple addition to your day, exactly as described on the label.

headline: What's Actually In The Bottle?
body: No blends, no proprietary formulas — just organic hemp seeds, cold-pressed into oil. See for yourself what 'simple' really looks like.

headline: Cold-Pressed. Single Ingredient. No Guesswork.
body: We press organic hemp seeds at low temperature to keep the oil as close to its natural state as possible. It's the same oil in every bottle, made the same careful way each time.

headline: Not CBD Oil. Just Hemp Seed Oil.
body: Erbology Hemp Seed Oil comes from the seed, not the plant's CBD-rich parts — a distinct, organic, cold-pressed oil with its own simple profile. Worth knowing before you buy.
